facts.fact: Ethiopia officially became a member of PAPSS on 15 October 2026, per Birr Metrics, though the document gives no date from which Ethiopian customers can use it.

ETH.note: Document does not mention consumer protection.
Membership since 2026-10-15 is stated but the document says the date Ethiopian customers can use cross-border services is unspecified, so no service in place is shown.
Document does not mention government payments to people.
Document gives no account-ownership survey figure for Ethiopia.

facts.fact: Birr Metrics says Ethiopia's EthSwitch facilitates interoperability between banks and payment service providers.

ETH.note: Document does not mention tax or fee payment.
